steps.note: Open the eRFX project create screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test company.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation so the title is the only missing prerequisite.
Configure the project as RFQ-only without combining RFQ and Auction.
Apply the available RFQ pricing template.
Add the CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB line item with quantity 10.
Complete the remaining pricing-sheet fields for the line item.
Set the requested delivery location on the line item.
Add one QA test vendor, satisfying the participant prerequisite without inventing a vendor name.
Attempt Publish and assert the app refuses because the project title was deliberately left blank.
